title: HDFC Shoppers Stop Black credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Shoppers Stop Black variant delivering premium shopping rewards, milestone vouchers, and exclusive perks for loyal Shoppers Stop customers.

benefitRows.name: First Citizen
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary Shoppers Stop Black membership worth Rs 4500.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, visit the Shoppers Stop First Citizen website. Register or log in, then link your HDFC Shoppers Stop Black credit card to activate your First Citizen membership benefits including exclusive offers and invites.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Emergency overseas hospitalization coverage upto ₹50 lakhs, credit liability cover upto ₹9 lakhs, and zero liability on fraudulent transactions upon immediate reporting of a lost card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Business Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.
